status: a measurement. 'carried' = the game's code read the byte before writing it at least once after a load: an observation (constants that are only read are in it; the GPU's and the fibers' readers are outside the trace; that some of it is needed is shown by the negative controls only). 'recomputed' places are CANDIDATES only: left alone over the ring's 150 loads they crash or hang the game (2026-11-13) - written first at the recorded load points is not written first from every frame.

fields.name: pos_changed (pos differed from prev_pos at slot 0x160)
ignore_link_scale (scale uses owner_scale instead of link_scale)
color[MODEL_COLOR_TYPE] {rgb f32x3, a f32, pad 16, f32 x2 (1.0), u64}
gold_eye_flags (bit0 gold eye, bits1/2 other eye materials)
area entry table (container: +0x10 count, +0x18 array of 0x70-byte entries)
area contact log (container: +0x10 count, +0x18 array of 0x20-byte records)
area param table (static default; +0x10 count, +0x18 array of 4 x u32 rows)
sleep state (0 awake, 1 sleeping, 2 wake pending)
per-area-kind blocks (11 = FIGHTER_AREA_KIND_NUM), pointer at block+0x10 zeroed
module's own area instance (head of the CHILD-chained instances)
+0x2C0 vector (reset to a global constant vector)
groups (-> embedded group at +0x50, 0x2d0 bytes each)
group.list_a (empty: points to itself) + count u32 at +0x290
lr / scale (float of start and update)
owner_effect_id (14-bit object serial | 0x1000000; also the match key of this object's live effects in the global effect list)
common_effect_set (ring buffer of Hash40 entries: count +0x10, capacity +0x8, start +0x18, data +0x28)
se_slot[16] {vptr +0x0, sound handle object +0x8, u32 label +0x10, u32 kind +0x14 (0x870065 = none), u8 flag +0x18, u64 -1 +0x20, f32 volume +0x28, u16 +0x38, ...}
script_work_area (0x18D bytes zeroed by the builder)
status_data (vector of 176-byte entries = 22 lua function references, one entry per status kind)
